entries.16d8760a824df005: The restaurant business is a single segment, and all of the revenue of ¥30,219 million for the fiscal year ended December 2025 came from in-store sales in Japan. Sales by region were ¥13,561 million in the Tokai region, ¥10,564 million in the Kanto region, ¥4,903 million in the Kansai region, ¥660 million in the Kyushu region and ¥528 million in other regions, with the Tokai region, the company's birthplace, being the largest. The total of 161 stores comprises 146 BRONCO BILLY stores, 14 tonkatsu-format stores and one izakaya-format store, and no major customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue.

entries.9879b0a252012d50: Its main steaks and hamburgers are processed at its own factory and shipped to stores daily, and vegetables are also delivered every day; under this system, it provides meals that combine charcoal-grilled steaks and hamburgers with fresh salad (salad bar).
entries.c45bdf145353f7e0: Steaks and hamburgers are processed at its own factory and shipped to stores every day, and vegetables are also delivered daily, maintaining freshness. The group handles purchasing, product development and product manufacturing in an integrated manner, and by also using ingredients that require processing, such as irregular products that do not circulate in the market, it achieves reduced food loss and low-cost purchasing. Its store format, featuring an open kitchen with charcoal grills, a large kamado and a salad bar, is also a distinctive feature.
entries.c8ed9eb0c97de9b3: Based on its corporate philosophy, its mission is to create customers, and its basic management policy is to improve the quality of the three "gochisō" elements of "finest food," "finest service" and "finest space," and to realize its concept of the Gochisō Company. Over the medium to long term, it plans to carefully select properties expected to be profitable and aims to expand into the Tokai, Kanto, Kansai and Kyushu regions, with all stores directly operated.

entries.dcabe454c3864274: In the fiscal year ended December 2025, the company opened "Bronco Billy" restaurants in 3 locations in Gunma Prefecture, 2 in Saitama Prefecture, and 1 each in Osaka, Hyogo and Fukuoka Prefectures, and closed 1 restaurant, bringing the Group to a total of 161 restaurants. It drew customers through promotions such as the 140 restaurants milestone thanksgiving festival and the introduction of limited-quantity high-quality steaks, and its subsidiary Les Vins Co., Ltd. held the 30th anniversary thanksgiving festival of "Katsumasa". At Matsuyaeishokuhinhonpo Co., Ltd., production for the company's restaurants exceeds 6 tenths of its output, and it has also begun over-the-counter sales of room-temperature steak sauce and dressings.
